title: Core rules
summary: Short answers, honest pushback, no long dashes and readable pages. Loaded every session.
benefit: Answers stay short and honest, and Claude tells you when your plan looks wrong.
solves: Long, padded answers, guessed facts and reports that are hard to read.
use_cases: A simple question gets only the answer: no preamble, summary or next steps.
Your plan looks wrong: Claude says what, why and what it recommends before acting, once.
Claude says plainly what it has not verified and never invents APIs, flags, paths or sources.
Any page or report: summary first, detail collapsed, checked with a screenshot (readable-pages skill).
No em dash or en dash anywhere: replies, files, code or commits.
details: Claude gives short direct answers, honest pushback when your plan looks wrong, no em or en dashes, and readable pages and reports (a small readable-pages skill holds the page rules and loads on demand). It applies to every project and every session. It adds one plain-text rule file under ~/.claude/rules/ and one skill folder; no code runs and no network is used.
risk: Text only, loaded into every session. No code runs.
